product_one_liner.value: Vim connects healthcare systems, data and applications inside EHR workflows so providers, payers and health-tech companies can deploy clinical tools and AI-powered workflows.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the public navigation/footer; the commercial information directs buyers to request a quote rather than publishing plans.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is predominantly product, industry and marketing content. One clearly engineer-authored secure-coding post was found, but not the required two posts about building the product.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official job board states: There are no current openings.

model_provider.notes: No named product model/provider was found in the public developer documentation, AI/product material, trust center or privacy/vendor disclosures reviewed; no public AI subprocessor list was located. Cursor references concern internal development, not the product model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Vim claims SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance; HIPAA is a compliance claim rather than an independent certification.

last_funding.notes: The company identifies its 2021 financing as Series C; the investment announcement is dated May 5, 2021. Amount is omitted because funding databases report $36 million while contemporaneous reporting describes $60 million; the company announcement does not disclose an amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest documented financing is May 2021, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official job board states: There are no current openings; archived sales postings are not counted.

launched_6mo.notes: No dated major launch was found during May 9–November 9, 2026. The readable announcement history places the Vim Connect platform/marketplace announcement on October 20, 2025. The current site introduces AgentFlow without a launch date, so it cannot establish an in-window launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A January 15, 2026 announcement congratulates Jonah Remz on his appointment as VP of Finance at Vim, inside the November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The archived Revenue Operations Manager posting describes ownership of HubSpot and operating these marketing/outbound automation systems. Salesforce and Zapier/Make/Workato appear as candidate experience alternatives, not confirmed Vim deployments.
